_comment: The registered services no boto3 test can exercise, and why. Read by test/compatibility/_coverage.py and by cmd/devcloud/coverage_test.go, which derives the Compatibility-tested figure docs/coverage.md publishes. Adding an entry lowers that figure; it is a deliberate edit, and two gates fail until the doc moves with it.

noBoto3Client.azurequeue: Azure Queue Storage uses the azure-storage-queue SDK, not boto3
noBoto3Client.azuretable: Azure Table Storage uses the azure-data-tables SDK, not boto3
noBoto3Client.blob: Azure Blob Storage uses the azure-storage-blob SDK, not boto3
noBoto3Client.cosmosdb: Azure Cosmos DB uses the azure-cosmos SDK, not boto3
noBoto3Client.gcs: Google Cloud Storage uses the google-cloud-storage SDK, not boto3
noBoto3Client.identity: DevCloud Federated Identity Playground uses direct OIDC/OAuth2 endpoints, not boto3
noBoto3Client.sagemakerruntimehttp2: botocore has no HTTP/2 SageMaker Runtime client
noBoto3Client.transcribestreaming: botocore has no streaming Transcribe client

unreachableFromBoto3.codecatalyst: codecatalyst authenticates with a bearer token rather than SigV4, and botocore raises NoAuthTokenError before the request is built
unreachableFromBoto3.cloudfrontkeyvaluestore: the client resolves its endpoint from a KVS ARN, so botocore raises EndpointResolutionError instead of honouring endpoint_url
